description: fz-bin.3 probe after fz-bin.5/fz-bin.8: fixtures2/behavior/enum_predicate_search.fz no longer reports unresolved multi-target protocol dispatch, but both run and interp panic in jobs/transport.rs:186 with 'transport shape anchors disagree for connected position component: ExecutableInput ... semantic_index: 1 left ShapeId(13) right ShapeId(16)'. This appears when Enum predicate/search callbacks route through multi-target protocol dispatch and connect incompatible callback/accumulator transport shapes. Investigate transport unioning for dispatch call-edge arms and callback inputs before re-enabling enum_predicate_search.
title: Transport anchors disagree for Enum predicate dispatch callbacks
